io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.storage.backend.legacy

Class LegacyFileBackend

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.storage.backend.legacy.LegacyFileBackend
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    BlockStorageBackend

    @Beta
public class LegacyFileBackend
extends java.lang.Object
implements BlockStorageBackend
    File-based (legacy) implementation of BlockStorageBackend. Reads the same .sfb/.sfc/.sfi files and uses the exact same parsing helpers as the pre-SP-1 BlockStorage, so the on-disk format is unchanged.

    This API is still experimental, it may change without notice.

      • deleteBlocks

        public void deleteBlocks(@Nonnull
                         org.bukkit.World world,
                         @Nonnull
                         java.util.Collection<org.bukkit.Location> locations)
        Description copied from interface: BlockStorageBackend
        Explicitly deletes the block rows at the given Locations. The dirty per-id Config objects passed to BlockStorageBackend.flushBlocks(World, Map) are delta-only (they don't carry the "full known state" the legacy .sfb file did), so a removed location is simply absent from them - indistinguishable from "not touched". This method is the explicit signal backends need to actually delete a row.
        Specified by:
        deleteBlocks in interface BlockStorageBackend
        Parameters:
        world - The World the locations belong to.
        locations - The Locations to delete.
        Implementation Note:
        Intentionally a no-op. Legacy deletions are encoded implicitly by flushBlocks(org.bukkit.World, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, me.mrCookieSlime.CSCoreLibPlugin.Configuration.Config>) rewriting the full .sfb file (or deleting it when empty) from the file-loaded Config, which the removed location is already absent from.
